x.Description: x position in MNI152NLin6Asym (FSL MNI152 2 mm), converted from voxel_i as x = 90 - 2*voxel_i (see coordsystem.json).

y.Description: y position in MNI152NLin6Asym (FSL MNI152 2 mm), converted from voxel_j as y = 2*voxel_j - 126 (see coordsystem.json).

z.Description: z position in MNI152NLin6Asym (FSL MNI152 2 mm), converted from voxel_k as z = 2*voxel_k - 72 (see coordsystem.json).

voxel_i.Description: First voxel index of the contact in the FSL MNI152_T1_2mm grid (0-based), copied verbatim from column 'MNI X' of sourcedata/dryad-q573n5tph/allContacts_MNIcoords.csv.

voxel_j.Description: Second voxel index of the contact in the FSL MNI152_T1_2mm grid (0-based), copied verbatim from column 'MNI Y' of allContacts_MNIcoords.csv.

voxel_k.Description: Third voxel index of the contact in the FSL MNI152_T1_2mm grid (0-based), copied verbatim from column 'MNI Z' of allContacts_MNIcoords.csv.

atlas_label_AAL3v1.Description: Derived for NEMAR (2026-10-08), not given by the authors: label of the AAL3v1 atlas (Rolls et al. 2020, MNI152, 1 mm) at the contact position, nearest labelled voxel within 4 mm, else n/a. voxel indices in the MNI152 2 mm template converted to mm with the FSL MNI152_T1_2mm affine (x=-2i+90, y=2j-126, z=2k-72); the 0-based reading was verified in Oct 2026 (see coordsystem.json), and x, y, z now hold these millimetre values.

atlas_label_DesikanKilliany.Description: Derived for NEMAR (2026-10-08), not given by the authors: label of FreeSurfer fsaverage mri/aparc+aseg.mgz (Desikan-Killiany cortical parcels + aseg structures, MNI305 space; the MNI152/MNI305 difference is ignored) at the contact position; cortical/subcortical label within 4 mm if the voxel is unlabelled, white-matter labels kept as such, else n/a. voxel indices in the MNI152 2 mm template converted to mm with the FSL MNI152_T1_2mm affine (x=-2i+90, y=2j-126, z=2k-72); the 0-based reading was verified in Oct 2026 (see coordsystem.json), and x, y, z now hold these millimetre values.
